name: zeromind
description: ZeroMind for Claude Code: the `zeromind` MCP server at origozero.ai/mcp (content discovery, worlds, and the engine tools of the world you have open) plus the skills that teach the agent to check ZeroMind first. Link this machine once with `npx -y @origozero/zeromind link` — REQUIRES Node.js 18+ (install from https://nodejs.org if needed, then restart Claude Code).
